Opening Date: July 20th

Golden Theater
22 West, Alisa Avenue, Administrative District

The best offering this year from the Golden Theater Musical Department
Citizen Alexandra

Toward the end of the third Guardian Alexandra's life, her heart was incessantly filled with guilt
A beautiful maiden stepped up to the political arena, giving up her personal life, carrying out her duties with utmost determination
The Architects guide her on the Path of Preservation. The count grew close with her but never formalized their relationship. The commander of the Silvermane Guards fought alongside her
When she looks back on her life, will she lament on her many missed chances at love? 
"Alexandra, do you have regrets?"

Three Goliards Awards for Best Actor in a Musical awardees Tony, Andy, and Jonathan
A joint performance unlike any other
The youngest Goliards Award winner for Best Musical Orchestration Catherine
The latest masterpiece after a two-year hiatus
Six-time Goliards Lifetime Achievement Award Winner Olivia
Highest recommendations

Newcomer with potential Dasha
As Lead Actress
